invariants.rule: GlassHelix owns scientific evidence, hypotheses and inference policy; Cellerator owns reusable numerical execution, derivatives and residency. The experiment is an independent installed client, not core biology.
Population snapshots are not individual histories; clone membership is shared ancestry, not row pairing. Withheld targets and ATAC-derived features cannot enter unauthorized fitting or conditioning.
Numerical failure, failed optimization, unresolved explanations and biological uncertainty are distinct. Candidate agreement is not a uniqueness proof; no observation or result is fabricated.
Preserve NF1A source and successful evidence, unrelated work, preprint content and separate Todo authorities. No historical retirement, runtime replacement or broad cleanup is authorized.
Build one real end-to-end learning slice before broadening capabilities. Reuse native execution and qualification; create durable tasks only for durable outcomes or ownership boundaries.

tasks.title: Conditional numerical support for GH learning
tasks.objective: Close only the selected minimal native extension. Aggregate, not coordinator seat or prerequisite.

required: CE-L1-ENABLE has executed evidence, producer/install identity and a consumer receipt. No unrelated numerical expansion.

tasks.next_action: Close after CE-L1-ENABLE. Do not import this optional plan before a concrete numerical capability gap is selected.

tasks.title: Supply the exact numerical path the learner needs
tasks.objective: Extend or connect existing CE owners for the selected GH learning workload: actual forward/response composition, shared-parameter accumulation, needed evidence reductions and generation-safe value updates.

required: Accept a compact demand record identifying the chosen model operations, derivatives, dimensions and the demonstrated missing native route.

Reuse existing contracts, parameter/relation storage, programs and derivatives. Implement only capabilities needed by the slice; no parallel evaluator, AD engine, broad optimizer library, speculative encoding or universal compiler.

Native tests cover actual connected parameter gradients, repeated/shared operands, admissibility, missing/masked evidence behavior where relevant, and stale generations; execute required CUDA tests through the existing authorized scheduler.
Publish an installed candidate and exact source/build/test receipt consumable by GH. Do not require GH-L1-LEARN to be complete before delivering it.
no_change_required is allowed only with executed proof that the demanded route already works; then publish that proof.

tasks.motivation: CE fills a demonstrated computational gap; the scientific model is not distorted to fit a convenient legacy operation.
delegated_choices: Choose existing owners and minimal new operations. Use simple updates first; expose sufficient numerical actions without imposing an optimizer policy.
tasks.next_action: Read the selected demand from GH, inspect exact relevant CE owners, implement or prove reuse, then bind actual required native gates and finish.
tasks.notes: Independent CE claim required. GH dependency evidence is a producer demand, not a foreign local task dependency. Keep successful NF1A and unrelated active work intact.

charter.objective: Meet one demonstrated learning workload through existing Cellerator numerical owners.
boundaries: Optional plan: import only after the GH owner selects native extension over verified reuse.
Separate CE Todo/Git authority; no GH writes under this claim.
No dependency on completed GH learner; deliver a tested native capability for it.
acceptance_conditions: Exact installed producer candidate with current native and relevant CUDA evidence.
charter.delegated_judgment: Choose narrow implementation and cheap configured delegates; no pre-created speculative numerical branches.
